description: Attribution control for reviewer-loads-injected: the SAME test-reviewer dispatch on the same input, but with NO skill injection. With nothing injected, test-reviewer relies on its @-referenced `testing` skill (inlined, no Skill call) and must NOT invoke android-testing — so the hook log must not contain it. Pairing 'android-testing present when injected' with 'absent when not' proves the log signal is caused by the injection, not ambient behaviour (non-vacuous).
